outlook.statement: Your directors are hopeful that the performance of the Company will further improve in the coming years.

The outlook for the Company remains positive, supported by structural demand in the real assets and construction sector. Ambitious Plastomac Company Limited aims to scale its execution bandwidth, bid selectively for margin-accretive contracts, and explore partnerships across commercial and infrastructure project lines. Management remains committed to maintaining a lean operating model, improving liquidity cycles, and deploying capital prudently to generate long-term stakeholder value.

risks: Input Cost Volatility: Fluctuations in key raw material prices (steel, cement, aggregates) and logistics costs may exert margin pressure on fixed-price or long-gestation contracts.
Regulatory & Approval Cycles: Land clearances, local municipal permits, and compliance adherence under state-level frameworks can impact project delivery schedules.

Market Competition: Stiff competition from both organized infrastructure developers and unorganized local contractors requires continuous operational cost discipline and competitive bidding capabilities.
Execution & Delay Risk: Delays arising from supply-chain interruptions, labor availability, or client-side site clearances could affect project timelines.
Credit & Working Capital Risk: Elongated payment cycles from project counterparties require active receivables monitoring to prevent cash-flow mismatches.
Regulatory Compliance Risk: Changes in municipal building norms, environmental regulations, or corporate statutory mandates require proactive compliance systems.
